variants.name: 30rd Stanag
variants.info:
Loads your M249 SAW with a standard 30rd STANAG magazine, sacrificing a lot of ammo for a lot more mobility, faster handling and shorter reload time!
Very large ammo pool, slight decrease in vertical kick at the cost of some left bias kick due to the uneven weight.
Movement and handling is still heavier than a standard assault rifle!

variants.name: 200rd Box
variants.info:
A large 200 round box for the M249 SAW, this should let you last for a long while!
Comes at a significant cost of movement speed, handling and reload time due to the weight!

variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: 60rd Casket
variants.info:
Loads your M249 SAW with a 60rd STANAG casket magazine, eliminating a lot of reload time and weight!
Large ammo reserve pool, slight decrease in vertical kick at the cost of some left bias kick due to the uneven weight and will take longer to reload when empty!

variants.name: Armor Piercing
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to green tipped armor piercing rounds.
Increases bullet penetration (+30%) and torso damage multiplier (+5%) but reduces damage up close (-5%) range (-5%) and head damage multiplier (-4%).

variants.name: Hollow Point
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to hollow point rounds.
Increases damage up close (+15%), maximum damage range (+17.5%)!
But reduces torso multiplier (-15%), penetration (-62.5%) and bullet speed (-10%).
